comments: Hal's comments about files a & b: "This show listing is not complete, as it's missing the middle and the end. Sessions by Tokyo Blade and Robin George. The Tokyo Blade session was 'recorded last September', while the Robin George session was being broadcast for the first time. This dates the show to early 1985. The Friday Rock Show Wiki lists the latter as 25 Jan 1985. The gap between tracks 10 and 12 may or may not feature any music."
Pete's file brings the total recording length to 1hr 53min, it is almost certain that Tokyo Blade 'Breakout' is now the only track missing.
Update 06 December 2021 - now a full show (including the 'missing' Tokyo Blade track, files d) and e)!
